summary: A presentational file upload: drop zone and browse button with client-side checks (type, size, empty, count), and the list of files the caller is uploading with progress and remove. It sends nothing; an app adapter does the HTTP.

inputs.name: ariaLabelledBy
inputs.description: Id of the caller's own label element, used when there is no label.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Help text under the label (translated); describes the control.

inputs.name: dropLabel
inputs.description: The prompt inside the drop zone (translated).

inputs.name: accept
inputs.description: Extensions, media types and type/* wildcards, comma-separated; empty accepts any type.

inputs.name: maxSizeBytes
inputs.description: The largest file in bytes; null for no limit.

inputs.name: maxFiles
inputs.description: How many files the control holds at most, counting items; more than one allows multi-select.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: The current problem (translated), shown as an alert and describing the control.

inputs.name: items
inputs.type: readonly DgaFileUploadItem[] ({ id, name, status: 'pending' | 'uploading' | 'uploaded' | 'failed', progress?, detail?, errorText? })
inputs.description: The files the caller holds, with their upload status and progress (percent, or null for indeterminate).

inputs.name: removeLabel
inputs.description: The remove button's accessible name as a template with {name} (translated); without it rows have no remove button.

outputs.name: filesSelected
outputs.type: DgaFileSelection ({ accepted: File[], rejected: { file, reason: 'type' | 'size' | 'empty' | 'count' }[] })
outputs.description: Every pick or drop, split by the client-side checks; an empty selection when the dialog was left empty.

outputs.name: removed
outputs.description: The id of the row whose remove button was pressed.

slots.description: Extra content inside the drop zone, such as the chosen file's name.

a11y: A role=group named by the label (or ariaLabelledBy) and described by the hint and error. The native file input is hidden from assistive technology and the tab order; the native browse button opens it, so the control is fully keyboard-operable without drag and drop. File names are dir=ltr isolated; progress bars are labelled by their file name; each remove button is named for its file. Logical CSS mirrors in RTL.
